verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents itself as an open-model inference provider with a model catalog that lists each model's context, regions and per-tier price, served through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. However, no specific model families are named, so the breadth and currency of the catalog are unproven. Missing for 10: named families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS), evidence the catalog is broad and current, explicit description of shared serverless endpoints, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among a broad catalog of current open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) on shared serverless endpoints

citations.quote: Open-model inference provider for Europe, private by default.
